item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03295","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 19 after correct formulas; the required number is 9.","case2_error":"Reports unsupported 29 after the correct expression 65 − (22 + 24); the result should be 19.","reason":"Both append incorrect final numbers to correct setups without showing an erroneous calculation.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03296","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan’s share, omitting Chris’s withdrawal.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final 30 after the correct formula (32 + 13 + 15) − 20, which yields 40.","reason":"The first omits a required withdrawal; the second states the correct relation but supplies an unsupported wrong result.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03297","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35 × 0.2857 as 9.5; it is approximately 10.","case2_error":"Doubles Bruce’s regular daily count for Sunday instead of doubling Paul’s Sunday count.","reason":"The first is a numerical multiplication error; the second uses the wrong comparison quantity in its relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03298","case1_error":"Calculates fuel cost by multiplying miles by dollars per gallon, omitting conversion from miles to gallons.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 90, but the derivation correctly obtains 45 students.","reason":"The second has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03299","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated 3, substituting the beetle consumption rate.","case2_error":"Subtracts the dog’s eyes from an already net count, then divides 22 eyes among people without converting eyes to fish.","reason":"The first substitutes an incorrect rate; the second reverses the eye-total adjustment and omits the eyes-to-fish conversion.","judgment":"different"}]}
